name: Seuls
source:
In a world where all anthro wolves disappeared 400 years ago, Paul-Loup, a canine living in France, will meet an unexpected big wolf called Charles. Together they will both learn more about themselves, and try to figure it out how to fit in this world, where their differences could be a problem for the society, besides of being exposed to a greater threat.

Alones is a furry gay visual novel, more like a romance "my wolf" thing, with a pinch of French culture and food.

[From [url=https://wackywoof.itch.io/alones]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在400年前所有兽人狼消失的世界里，居住在法国的一只犬科兽人Paul-Loup将遇见一只出乎意料的巨狼Charles。他们将一同更了解自己，并试着找出如何在这个世界融入生活。彼此的差异可能会带来社会阻碍，此外还有更大的威胁等待着他们。

《Alones》是一部福瑞题材的男男恋爱视觉小说，主打“我的狼”式恋情，并融入一点法国文化与美食。

[摘自[url=https://wackywoof.itch.io/alones]Itch.io[/url]]
